title: Accounts & Administration Assistant
description:
Blue Arrow is urgently recruiting for an Accounts & Administration Assistant to join our clients team based in the Llansamlet area.

Salary: Up to 27,000 pa

Hours of work: Mon - Fri 9am-5pm

Contract: Permanent

Our client is a well-established property management and chartered surveying firm, providing professional services across residential & commercial portfolios and are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented individual to support their finance and administrative operations.

The Accounts and Administration Assistant will play a key role in supporting the day-to-day financial and administrative functions of the business. This is a varied role requiring excellent organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Main Responsibilities:
- Accounts Support
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable processes
- Reconcile bank statements and client accounts
- Process invoices, receipts, and payments
- Maintain accurate financial records and filing systems
- Support month-end and year-end financial reporting
- Liaise with clients and suppliers regarding account queries
- Administration duties
- Provide general administrative support to the team
- Manage incoming calls, emails, and correspondence
- Maintain office supplies and equipment
- Assist with document preparation, data entry, and filing
- Support property management tasks such as issuing tenancy agreements, notices, and correspondence
- Schedule appointments, meetings, and inspections

Skills/Qualifications required:
- Administration experience (essential)
- GCSEs (or equivalent) in Maths and English
- Previous experience in an accounts or administrative role (Land property sector experience desirable)
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook)
- Experience with accounting software (e.g., Xero, Sage, QuickBooks) is an advantage
- Strong organisational and time management skills
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities
- High level of accuracy and attention to detail
- Accounts experience (desirable)

If you feel you have the right experience for the above role, please submit your CV for immediate response.

Blue Arrow is proud to be a Disability Confident Employer and is committed to helping find great work opportunities for great people.

title: Automotive Service Advisor
company: AKA The Recruitment Specialists - Agency - Permanent
description:
AKA Recruitment are proud to be working with a fantastic client to recruit experienced Service Advisors for vacancies based in Swansea . This is an excellent opportunity to join an established automotive business offering a competitive salary, a structured working pattern and long-term career prospects.

The role offers a basic salary of 32,598 per annum, rising to 33,575 following successful completion of the probationary period. Working hours are 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, with r ota hours between 7:00am and 6:00pm, plus one in three Saturday mornings from 8:00am to 1:00pm. - Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Ability to remain calm and work effectively under pressure, particularly for the Cardiff location.
- Good IT, administration and customer management skills.

Reasons to Apply:
- Competitive basic salary of 32,598, increasing to 33,575 after successful probation.
- 40-hour working week.
- Monday to Friday working pattern, with one in three Saturday mornings.
- Opportunity to join an established automotive business.
- Long-term career opportunity within the automotive industry.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Service Advisor looking to take the next step in their automotive career. If you have dealership experience, enjoy working in a customer-focused environment and are looking for a stable opportunity with a competitive salary, we would love to hear from you. To apply, please send your CV in confidence to AKA Recruitment, Aka reference number is 3905.

title: Document Controller
company: Elite Construction Talent Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Document Controller / Project Administrator Construction & Engineering

Location: Swansea, South Wales
Salary: £32,000 £38,000 per annum
Working Arrangement: Full-Time, Fully Site-Based

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an organised and detail-oriented Document Controller / Project Administrator to join an established contractor working on a substantial civil engineering project in South Wales.

This opportunity would suit an experienced Document Controller or a capable administrator looking to develop their career within a technical project environment.

Previous construction experience is desirable but not essential. We particularly welcome applications from candidates with backgrounds in engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, compliance, project administration or other technical environments.

The successful candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate project documentation, organising technical information and supporting the smooth running of document control processes.

Training and support will be available, so we are equally interested in candidates who demonstrate strong organisational skills, excellent attention to detail and a willingness to learn.

Please note: This is a fully site-based position. Hybrid and remote working are not available.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage and maintain project documentation, ensuring information is accurate, organised and readily accessible.
- Maintain document registers, trackers, spreadsheets and electronic filing systems.
- Coordinate the receipt, distribution and tracking of technical drawings, reports and project correspondence.
- Collate and organise quality assurance (QA) documentation and supporting records.
- Ensure documents are correctly filed, updated and issued in accordance with project procedures.
- Monitor outstanding documentation and follow up with relevant team members.
- Maintain accurate document revision records and assist with version control.
- Support engineers, supervisors and project managers with technical information and documentation requirements.
- Assist with preparing documentation for project reporting, inspections and handovers.
- Provide general project administration support as required.

Candidate Requirements
- Previous experience in document control, project administration, technical administration, quality administration or a similar role.
- Excellent organisational skills and a high level of attention to detail.
- Strong IT skills, particularly Microsoft Excel, Word and Outlook.
- Experience maintaining accurate records, databases, spreadsheets or electronic filing systems.
- Ability to collate, organise and manage information from multiple sources.
- Good communication skills and confidence liaising with different members of a project team.
- A methodical, proactive and reliable approach to work.
- Ability to prioritise tasks and maintain accuracy in a busy environment.
- Willingness to learn new systems, processes and technical terminology.
- Ability to work on site in the Port Talbot area, Monday to Friday.

Desirable but Not Essential
- Previous experience within construction, civil engineering, manufacturing or another technical industry.
- Familiarity with electronic document management systems (EDMS).
- Experience handling QA documentation, technical drawings or compliance records.
- Experience supporting engineering or project management teams.

What's on Offer?
- Competitive salary of £32,000 £38,000 per annum.
- Opportunity to work on a substantial civil engineering project.
- Training and support from experienced colleagues.
- Opportunity to develop specialist document control and technical administration skills.
- Varied responsibilities within an established project team.

Apply Now

If you are an organised, detail-oriented administrator with experience managing documentation, records or technical information, we would be keen to hear from you.

You do not need previous construction experience to be considered. Candidates from engineering, manufacturing, quality assurance, compliance and project administration backgrounds are encouraged to apply.

Please submit your CV or contact Elite Construction Talent for a confidential discussion.

title: Service Advisor
company: Perfect Placement Uk Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
We are seeking an experienced vehicle Service Advisor to join a well-established commercial vehicle dealership in Swansea.

The vehicle Service Advisor role offers excellent career development opportunities within a reputable franchise-approved dealer group, providing a wide range of benefits and a competitive salary package.

Benefits:
- Starting salary up to £32,598 per annum, with an increase to £33,575 after 6 months
- Access to a commitment bonus of £600 per year plus participation in a company profit share bonus scheme
- Additional earnings through commissions on the sale of service contracts
- 22 days annual holiday plus 8 bank holidays, increasing to 25 after 5 years and 27 after 10 years
- Full manufacturer-accredited training and ongoing professional development
- Company pension scheme
- Opportunities for long-term career progression
- Working hours: 40 hours per week, Monday to Friday, between 7:00am and 6:00pm, with one in three Saturdays (8:00am-1:00pm)

Duties as a Service Advisor:
- Accurately capturing customer details and vehicle faults at first contact
- Managing telephone bookings and inputting details into workshop systems
- Raising and preparing job cards, ensuring all necessary documentation is complete
- Updating customers on vehicle repair progress and advising on necessary repairs
- Selling additional services, including service contracts and warranties
- Arranging payments and discussing repair options with customers
- Coordinating workshop schedules to ensure timely vehicle repairs
- Explaining vehicle test requirements and arranging MOT/inspection appointments
- Providing excellent customer service through effective communication and problem-solving skills
- Maintaining accurate data entry into customer management systems such as Kerridge or ADP

Requirements:
- Proven experience as a vehicle Service Advisor within a franchise-approved dealership
- Strong customer service and communication skills
- Excellent organisational skills and proficiency with Microsoft Office, Excel, and DMS systems
- Full, clean UK driving licence with minimal points
- Knowledge of commercial vehicle dealership operations is desirable
- Ability to deliver high levels of customer satisfaction through professional conduct

If you meet these requirements and are eager to join a reputable dealership committed to employee development, we encourage you to apply.

Contact Harry Thaxton-Woodcock, Automotive Recruitment Specialist at Perfect Placement, covering Swansea and the South Wales region, today to discover more about this fantastic Service Advisor opportunity.

Perfect Placement are specialists in Automotive Recruitment. So if you are looking for a New Job in the Motor Trade, be sure to contact our team today.

title: Receptionist
description: Want to make a real difference and have a truly rewarding career? JoinNHS Wales Shared Services Partnership (NWSSP)and be part of a team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous learning. We are looking for an enthusiastic, committed and friendly individual to join our Corporate Services team, as a Receptionist, at Matrix House, Swansea. This is a key role in ensuring the smooth running of our reception and front of house services. The successful candidate will be responsible for providing clerical assistance to the Finance and Corporate Services Directorate and provide a friendly, efficient and professional reception service, including, but not limited to, customer service, administrative tasks and communication tasks. Welsh language skills are essential for this Receptionist role. Applicants must have Welsh speaking and listening skills at Level 3 (Intermediate/B1 CEFR). This means being able to communicate confidently in routine workplace situations, including welcoming visitors, answering and transferring telephone calls, taking and passing on messages, and responding to straightforward enquiries in Welsh. Act as the first point of contact for staff, visitors, and contractors. Manage a busy reception area, switchboard and deliveries. Maintain accurate records and stock control systems, for example, stationery items. Co-ordinate meeting room bookings and visitor access. Ensure compliance with data protection and confidentiality policies. Deliver excellent customer service and promote a positive image of NWSSP. To be responsible for providing clerical assistance to the Finance and Corporate Services Directorate and an effective reception service for NWSSP, including, but not limited to, all administrative tasks and communication tasks. Ensuring that friendly, efficient and professional service is provided at all times, which contributes to the delivery of an effective and customer focussed organisation. The post holder is expected to prioritise, manage their time well and demonstrate a high degree of flexibility. Handling sensitive and confidential information. The postholder will consistently deliver a client focussed service promoting good customer service and effective working relationships.
